<thought>We need to determine the number of methyl groups in the unknown molecule. The only way to get structural information is to retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, which should show distinct carbon signals. Methyl carbons typically appear in the 10‑30 ppm region. By counting the number of signals in that region we can infer the number of methyl groups.</thought>
